description: The environment variables the GitHub Actions record step (record-deployment.yml) hands to record-step.mjs, as GitHub would expand them for one fictional run. The local test runs the script with exactly these values, with RECORD_ENDPOINT_URL pointed at the local stub and the two token hops faked by the stub, and expects the stub to receive deployment.json. RECORD_ENDPOINT_SCOPE is empty, as an undefined configuration variable is. Fictional data only.

variables.RECORD_ENDPOINT_URL: set by the test to the local stub
